purpose: Configurable legal functional typing cues for offline diagnostics. This file does not drive retrieval, rerank, anchor injection, risk supplement, or answer generation.

functional_types.label: 法律责任
functional_types.description: Penalty, compensation, administrative liability, civil liability, or criminal liability clauses.

functional_types.label: 定义条款
functional_types.description: Clauses that define legal terms, regulated objects, entities, or concepts.

functional_types.label: 权利救济
functional_types.description: Clauses that grant rights, remedies, complaint channels, correction, deletion, withdrawal, or review rights.

functional_types.label: 程序要求
functional_types.description: Filing, reporting, assessment, approval, notice, deadline, material submission, or review process clauses.

functional_types.label: 义务/责任规则
functional_types.description: Substantive obligations, prohibitions, conditions, duties, compliance actions, or required safeguards.

functional_types.label: 适用范围
functional_types.description: Applicability, jurisdiction, object scope, subject scope, or excluded scope clauses.

functional_types.label: 原则条款
functional_types.description: General principles, policy goals, fairness, necessity, proportionality, transparency, or good-faith clauses.

functional_types.label: 技术标准
functional_types.description: Technical standard, guideline, recommended specification, or implementation detail clauses.

functional_types.label: 背景/边缘上下文
functional_types.description: Contextual or peripheral material that does not itself support the legal conclusion.

functional_types.label: 未分类
functional_types.description: Fallback when no stable functional type can be inferred.
